    The labels P_x, S_x, I_x of k(Γ_A) #

    The data used in the paragraph "Injectives in the image" of the proof of Proposition 2.10 (graded-category.tex): for a projective label P_x, the original simple S_x = P_x / rad P_x and the original injective I_x = D(Ae_x), with

    • dim C(P_y, S_x) = dim Hom_A(P_y, S_x) = δ_{xy},
    • dim C(S_y, I_x) = dim Hom_A(S_y, I_x) = δ_{xy},
    • dim C(P_y, I_x) = dim I_x e_y = dim e_yAe_x = dim C(P_x, P_y),

    all through eq:graded-hom-dimensions (finrank_meshHom).

    Module.finrank k (S.meshObj b x ⟶ S.meshObj b y) = Module.finrank k (S.fg (S.index x) ⟶ S.fg (S.index y))
